tiktok.description: Video, audio, channels, and bulk downloads without a watermark.

douyin.description: The Chinese version of TikTok, fully supported via Apify.

facebook.description: Videos, Reels, live VODs, and bulk downloads from pages and groups.

threads.description: Video and images from public Threads posts.

soundcloud.description: Download tracks, playlists, and artist channels.

spotify.description: Downloads via YouTube matching (high accuracy for popular music).

youtube.note: May be slower than other platforms.

instagram.description: Reels, carousels, stories, and bulk profile downloads. Cookie required for private content.

twitter.description: Tweet videos, GIFs, and bulk timeline downloads. Cookie required for restricted tweets.

reddit.description: v.redd.it with audio merge, bulk subreddit downloads, cookie for NSFW.

bilibili.description: Video, playlists, bulk downloads by uploader, subtitles. Cookie for VIP content.

xiaohongshu.description: Video and carousel images. Some content may not be downloadable.
xiaohongshu.note: Only public content can be downloaded.

lemon8.description: Video and carousel images from public posts.

snapchat.description: Public Spotlight and Stories. Private content is not supported.

vk.description: Single videos and playlists from VKontakte.

podcast.description: Download episodes from an RSS feed or Apple Podcasts URL.
